q: Consider FCFS scheduling for processes P1 (arrival 0, burst 5), P2 (arrival 1, burst 3), P3 (arrival 2, burst 8). What is the average waiting time?
exp: P1 starts at 0 (WT 0), P2 starts at 5 (WT 4), P3 starts at 8 (WT 6); average = 10/3 = 3.33.

q: A system has 32-bit logical addresses and 4 KB pages. How many bits are used for the page number?
exp: 4 KB = 2^12, so the offset is 12 bits and the page number is 32 - 12 = 20 bits.

q: A Unix-like inode has 10 direct pointers and 1 single-indirect pointer. Block size is 1 KB and a block pointer is 4 bytes. What is the maximum file size?
exp: A single-indirect block holds 1024/4 = 256 pointers; total blocks = 10 + 256 = 266, so 266 KB.

q: Which of the following is NOT a requirement for a solution to the critical-section problem?
exp: The three requirements are mutual exclusion, progress and bounded waiting.

q: The command chmod 754 file sets the permissions to:
exp: 7 = rwx for owner, 5 = r-x for group, 4 = r-- for others.

q: Which of the following is NOT a necessary condition for deadlock?
options: Resource preemption (resources can be forcibly taken away)
exp: The four Coffman conditions are mutual exclusion, hold and wait, no preemption and circular wait; allowing preemption breaks deadlock.

q: Reference string: 1,2,3,4,1,2,5,1,2,3,4,5 with 3 frames and FIFO replacement. How many page faults occur?
exp: Faults on 1,2,3,4,1,2,5,3,4 (the references to 1,2 after 5 and to 5 at the end are hits) = 9.

q: Which of the following is NOT stored in the Process Control Block (PCB) of a process?
options: The complete source code of the program
The process state and process ID
exp: The PCB holds execution context and bookkeeping information (PC, registers, state, PID, scheduling data), not the source code.

q: The disk head is at cylinder 50. The request queue (in arrival order) is 82, 170, 43, 140, 24, 16, 190. What is the total head movement under FCFS?
In a batch operating system:
options: similar jobs are collected and executed together with no user interaction during execution
users interact with every job through terminals in real time
the CPU is shared in equal time slices among users
exp: Batch systems group jobs with similar needs and run them sequentially without interaction.
Two successive forks create 2² = 4 processes, and each prints A once.

q: Direct Memory Access (DMA) is used to:
options: transfer blocks of data between a device and memory without CPU involvement for each byte
increase the clock speed of the CPU
exp: The DMA controller moves data directly and interrupts the CPU only after the whole transfer finishes.

q: Non-preemptive SJF: P1 (arrival 0, burst 7), P2 (2, 4), P3 (4, 1), P4 (5, 4). What is the average waiting time?
A system has a 64 KB logical address space, 1 KB pages and 32 KB of physical memory. How many frames are there in physical memory?
exp: Number of frames = 32 KB / 1 KB = 32.

q: With block size 4 KB and 4-byte block pointers, how many data blocks can be addressed through one single-indirect block?
exp: 4096 / 4 = 1024 pointers per indirect block.

q: A counting semaphore is initialised to 10. Then 14 P (wait) operations and 9 V (signal) operations are completed on it. What is the final value of the semaphore?
exp: Final value = 10 - 14 + 9 = 5.

q: With a umask of 022, the default permissions of a newly created regular file are:
exp: Files start from 666; removing the umask bits 022 gives 644.

q: A system has 10 identical units of one resource. Allocations are P0 = 3, P1 = 2, P2 = 2 and maximum needs are P0 = 7, P1 = 4, P2 = 5. Which of the following is NOT a safe sequence?
exp: Available = 10 - 7 = 3; needs: P0 4, P1 2, P2 3. P0 cannot go first (4 > 3), so any sequence starting with P0 is unsafe. P1 or P2 can start (e.g. P1, P2, P0 and P2, P0, P1 are safe).

q: For the reference string 1,2,3,4,1,2,5,1,2,3,4,5, FIFO gives 9 faults with 3 frames and 10 faults with 4 frames. This behaviour is called:
exp: More frames producing more faults under FIFO is Belady's anomaly.

q: In the five-state process model, a running process moves to the ready state when:
options: the I/O it was waiting for completes
it is first created by the system
exp: Timer interrupt at the end of the quantum preempts the running process and places it in the ready queue; I/O request leads to blocked state.

q: Preemptive SJF (SRTF) with P1 (arrival 0, burst 7), P2 (2, 4), P3 (4, 1), P4 (5, 4). What is the average waiting time?
Head at cylinder 50; request queue 82, 170, 43, 140, 24, 16, 190. What is the total head movement under SSTF?
A time-sharing operating system achieves good response time for many users by:
options: giving each user a dedicated CPU
running one job to completion at a time
switching the CPU rapidly among users' programs using a small time slice
exp: Time slicing makes each user feel they have a dedicated machine.

q: A C program calls fork() three times in sequence (no conditions). How many child processes are created in total?
exp: Total processes = 2³ = 8, including the original, so 7 are children.

q: Page size is 1 KB and page 2 of a process is mapped to frame 7. What physical address corresponds to logical address 2100?
A disk of 128 MB uses 2 KB blocks and a FAT with 2-byte entries (one entry per block). What is the size of the FAT?
exp: Blocks = 128 MB / 2 KB = 65,536 entries; × 2 B = 131,072 B = 128 KB.

q: Round Robin with time quantum 3 ms. P1, P2, P3 all arrive at 0 with bursts 7, 4 and 2 ms respectively (in that order). At what time does P2 complete?
For using a semaphore to enforce mutual exclusion among processes, the semaphore is initialised to:
exp: A binary semaphore initialised to 1 lets exactly one process enter the critical section.

q: What does the option -i do in the command grep -i "error" log.txt?
options: Ignores the case of letters while matching
exp: -i makes grep case-insensitive, so Error, ERROR and error all match.

q: A system has 12 tape drives. Maximum demands / current allocations: P0 10/5, P1 4/2, P2 9/2. Which sequence is safe?
exp: Available = 12 - 9 = 3; needs: P0 5, P1 2, P2 7. P1 runs → avail 5; P0 runs → avail 10; P2 (7 ≤ 10) runs.

q: Compared with interrupt-driven I/O, polling:
options: is always faster for slow devices
makes the CPU repeatedly check the device status, wasting CPU time
exp: In polling the CPU busy-waits on a status bit; interrupt-driven I/O lets the CPU do other work.

q: Reference string: 1,2,3,4,1,2,5,1,2,3,4,5 with 3 frames and LRU replacement. How many page faults occur?
exp: Faults at 1,2,3,4,1,2,5,3,4,5 = 10 (only the two middle references to 1 and 2 hit).

q: Which of the following resources is shared by all threads of the same process?
options: The heap memory and global variables
exp: Threads share code, data, heap and open files; each thread has its own stack, program counter and registers.

q: Head at cylinder 50 moving toward cylinder 0 on a disk with cylinders 0-199; queue 82, 170, 43, 140, 24, 16, 190. What is the total head movement under SCAN?
exp: 50 → 0 costs 50 (servicing 43, 24, 16), then 0 → 190 costs 190; total 240.

q: Which of the following is an example of a hard real-time system?
options: An aircraft flight-control or pacemaker controller
exp: In hard real-time systems missing a deadline is a failure; streaming is soft real-time.

q: TLB hit ratio is 80%, TLB lookup takes 20 ns and a memory access takes 100 ns (single-level page table). What is the effective access time?
Which of the following is NOT stored in the inode of a Unix file?
exp: The file name is stored in the directory entry, which maps the name to an inode number.

q: For the same Round Robin case (q = 3 ms; P1, P2, P3 arrive at 0 with bursts 7, 4, 2), what is the average turnaround time?
exp: Completion times are P1 13, P2 12, P3 8; all arrive at 0, so average TAT = 33/3 = 11.

q: In the bounded-buffer producer-consumer solution with a buffer of N slots, the semaphores empty, full and mutex are initialised respectively to:
exp: empty counts free slots (N), full counts filled slots (0) and mutex guards buffer access (1).

q: In the output of ls -l, a line beginning with the character 'd' (for example drwxr-xr-x) represents:
exp: The first character shows the file type: d for directory, - for regular file, l for symbolic link.
